item.title: 25 Years Later, GTA 3 Is Still the Most Fascinating Open-World Experiment
item.description: The artwork’s nothing to write home about, just a collage of pictures in red, blue, and green hues, featuring obscure faces, a police chopper, and a car up in flames. Your instinct is to just go with your gut; Silent Hill 2 is what you came here for, after all. But something’s telling you otherwise. Maybe it’s the store clerk going on about its open-world premise, or the name itself that strikes a chord within you. Whatever reason incites it, you make the ultimate decision. Little did you know, you’d be walking home with one of the greatest achievements in video game history.

item.title: Vinland Saga Creator Gives a Heartbreaking Update on the Anime's Third Season
item.description: Vinland Saga is one of the most critically acclaimed manga series of all time. Author Makoto Yukimura carefully brought to life a somber reflection on war and violence through the cast of compelling characters who populate this historical drama. Vinland Saga was adapted into an anime by Wit Studio in 2019. A second season, produced by MAPPA, aired in 2023. Since then, fans have been eagerly awaiting news of a continuation, but a sad update was just shared by Yukimura himself.

item.title: 187 Years Ago, a Gothic Horror Story Beat Edgar Allan Poe to the Locked-Room Mystery
item.description: Authors like Bram Stoker ( Dracula ), Henry James ( The Turn of the Screw ), and Wilkie Collins ( The Woman in White ) are considered prominent Victorian-era Gothic horror writers. That said, one must not forget J. Sheridan Le Fanu, who penned Carmilla , a pioneering lesbian vampire novella that predates Stoker’s Dracula by 25 years. Considered one of the best ghost story writers of his generation, Le Fanu is also known for his macabre poetry and his horror story collection, In a Glass Darkly .

item.title: Epic Games Is Just Trolling Fans at This Point With New $50k AI Game Contest
item.description: Epic Games is going beyond pushing its developers to use artificial intelligence and is now rounding up fans for an AI-based game development competition called the Epic AI MegaJam. Participants are encouraged to use AI tools to make a game in Unreal Engine or Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN). This so-called creativity competition is yet another controversial move, and at this point, it feels like Epic Games is just adding fuel to the fire.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Launch Trailer Was Changed for TV: Here Are All the Differences
item.description: Rockstar has put a tremendous amount of time and effort into creating Grand Theft Auto 6 . With its release date now closer than ever, the company is focusing its resources on promoting it. A commercial version of the recent GTA 6 launch trailer is now airing on TV, and eagle-eyed fans immediately noticed some changes, even if they were very slight.

item.title: 5 'Solo Leveling' Characters Who Deserved So Much Better
item.description: Jin-woo starts out as a weak E-Rank hunter trapped in a seemingly endless struggle to survive. Before long, though, he becomes an unstoppable force. His progression feels steady and earned, and his efforts to uncover the source of his abilities take him through a series of unforgettable fights.

item.title: 27 Years Later, Linus' Final 'Peanuts' Quote Is a Brilliant Comic Strip Callback
item.description: Charles Schulz's Peanuts , for whatever reason, has one of the more dedicated fan communities on the internet. The Peanuts Fandom wiki is an invaluable resource for anything you might want to know about the strip, from obscure characters to running jokes to the gang’s unofficial cameo appearances in later media like Family Guy . While Peanuts itself has been the subject of broad academic discussion since the end of its original run, its wiki has that dense block of exhaustive well-organized trivia that you only really get from dedicated fans. (They probably ought to get the Peanuts wiki off of Fandom at some point.)

item.title: Anya Taylor-Joy’s breakout movie gave horror a different kind of female lead
item.description: Anya Taylor-Joy has established herself as one of her era's most versatile actors. At 30, she's built a career across film and television , appearing in franchises like Super Mario and Mad Max , along with winning a Golden Globe for her role in The Queen’s Gambit . Earlier this year, she starred in the Apple TV series Lucky and will also play a major role in the cinematic event that is Dune: Part Three . Taylor-Joy is one of the few modern stars who comfortably fit the movie-star label, and it all began with her career-defining breakout role, which turned the final girl trope on its head — a girl who survives not by fighting, but by giving in.
